evals.name: scaffold-from-yaml
evals.prompt: I already have workflow.yaml from the agent-workflow-creator skill for a support ticket triage pipeline. Turn it into a runnable Python project and tell me what I still need to implement.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/scaffold_python_workflow.py, lists the generated stubs in tools.py that must be implemented, runs runner.py --check and the tests, and gives the run commands incl. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or RUNNER_FAKE_LLM dry run.

evals.name: right-size-the-solution
evals.prompt: I want an AI agent that renames and tags my uploaded invoices. Build it.
evals.expected_output: Recognises this is a fixed pipeline, not an open-ended agent: proposes a simple extract-then-rename chain (or single LLM call) with validation, rather than a tool-using agent loop; mentions idempotency/dry-run for renames.

evals.name: no-code-handoff
evals.prompt: My client uses n8n. Map my lead-qualification workflow to n8n nodes and explain how failures reach a human.
evals.expected_output: Uses references/no-code-automation.md: trigger, HTTP/LLM node, IF/Switch, parsing/validation node, error workflow notifying a person; advises exporting JSON from the editor rather than hand-writing node JSON.
